name: ultimate-frontend-skills
description: Ultimate Frontend Skills (UFS for Claude). Build cinematic, editorial websites, app screens and game start screens the way an award-winning studio does, on one route from brief to ship: a corpus of award-winning reference sites to decide against, WebGL mesh gradients, three-plane parallax with real depth, procedural and Blender-modelled three.js exploded product views, CC0 PBR materials and HDRI lighting, scroll choreography in GSAP and anime.js, and a typographic system that does not read as AI-generated. Ships a copy-in CSS chassis, motion and WebGL runtimes, a section library, a scaffolder, a headless render check, a bench detector that defers to frontend-design when it is installed, and one verify verdict.

interface.shortDescription: UFS for Claude: websites that look like a studio made them, not a model
interface.longDescription: A pinned art direction plus the code that produces it. Editorial serif typography at real optical sizes, warm-neutral and near-black grounds in OKLCH, cinematic photography with eased scrims, layered scroll parallax, and procedural or Blender-modelled three.js exploded views of a made thing taken apart. Ships a copy-in CSS chassis, motion and WebGL runtimes, a library of section archetypes, a scaffolder, and an audit that fails the build on placeholder copy, missing image dimensions, pure black and white, absent reduced-motion handling, and the other marks of a generated page.
defaultPrompt: Build me a landing page for a roofing company in Houston
Give this page a WebGL gradient hero and real parallax
Make this site look like it was designed, not generated
